restaurantName: Jurassic Afternoon Tea at The Ampersand
bio: Afternoon Tea Awards 2024 - Award of Excellence  Inspired by the award winning Science Afternoon Tea , The Ampersand have created a new Jurassic themed tea, taking its cue from a time when dinosaurs roamed the earth. Expect a mix of exciting and curious dishes including a Volcanic eruption, a Jurassic mountain and a Dinosaur egg basket.  Take a journey back in time to when the dinosaurs roamed the earth over 200 Million years ago and where gastronomy and history collide in a one of a kind dining experience.  Choose from Jurassic, Kids, Vegetarian, or Gluten free menus, with or without a glass of Charles Heidsieck Brut NV or Rosé Champagne, a glass of Wild Idol alcohol free sparkling rosé, or our Jurassic Tea Pot Tails with or without alcohol.  Jurassic Afternoon Tea is served every day at 12pm, 3pm and 6pm.  Please specify in the Special Requests box how many Adult/Children's Afternoon Teas you would like to book.
